title: Changelog
body: All notable changes to pagify. The format is based on Keep a Changelog , and this project adheres to Semantic Versioning . [Unreleased] Added MCP server command ( pagify mcp ) Frontmatter-based site configuration Light/dark theme favicons Full-height sidebar Changed Migrated to Goldmark v2 Sidebar now takes full viewport height [v0.1.0] - 2024-01-15 Added Initial release Zero-config Markdown to static site GitHub-flavored Markdown support Built-in search (client-side) Dark/light theme with toggle Responsive navigation Syntax highlighting Callouts (NOTE, TIP, WARNING, DANGER) Footnotes Tables and task lists Cross-page link rewriting Frontmatter support Local development server MCP server for AI integration Release Types Type Description Added New features Changed Changes in existing functionality Deprecated Soon-to-be removed features Removed Removed features Fixed Bug fixes Security Vulnerability fixes Links GitHub Releases GitHub Commits

title: v0.1.0
body: Released: January 15, 2024 Added Zero-configuration builds — Point at a directory of Markdown files, get a complete site GitHub-flavored Markdown — Tables, task lists, strikethrough, autolinks, footnotes Callouts — > [!NOTE] , > [!TIP] , > [!WARNING] , > [!DANGER] with aliases Built-in search — Client-side search index, no backend required Dark/light theme — Automatic OS detection, manual toggle, localStorage persistence Responsive design — Sidebar on desktop, drawer on mobile Syntax highlighting — Via CSS, no JavaScript required Cross-page links — .md links rewritten to clean URLs Frontmatter — Page metadata (title, description, order, label, draft) Site config via frontmatter — title, language, basePath, theme, footer in index.md Local dev server — pagify serve with live rebuild MCP server — pagify mcp for AI tool integration Single binary — Embedded assets, no Node.js, no runtime dependencies Fixed N/A (initial release) Security N/A (initial release)
